name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.dialog.LiveAdSuccessDialog
description: After a live-ad task passes its completion check, the Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK shows the advertiser, reward amount, completion tip, and a countdown before closing this screen.
disableEffect: This screen opens after the live-ad reward has already been verified; if it cannot open, the app may stop unexpectedly at the end of the ad.
